title: Excellent for moving & storage & floods!
text: I purchased these for multiple reasons. The main reason was that I was moving. I was moving bc my apt kept flooding.  Luckily having been through other floods I generally store all my stuff in plastic containers anyways. Sadly a couple of my vintage Singer’s in wooden boxes had been left out during the last move & the last flood got them moldy & ruined them.  I am a bibliophile & these bags held not only huge stacks of my hardcover books, but my 40 pound Singer sewing machines. I also carried hundreds of pounds of yarn (50 per bag) and thousands of pounds of quilting fabric during my move.  It held up to paints, plants, garden pits, & pretty much anything I threw at it. I even put my pots & pans in these bags.  While I still thought they were a bit pricey I did buy some on sale & I think I bought 18 total that I was able to pack & take to my new place & unload & go pack again. Tho I now intend to leave some of my yarn in them as it’s waterproof.  Tho I intend to place it on a top shelf just to be on the safe side. Lol. Not one bag ripped, tore, or had an issue so far that I am aware of tho I have not checked them over very well. And I had no issues with the zippers tho I am positive that I packed several bags well over the weight limit on accident bc I was trying to keep certain quilting fabrics together for a quilt project.  I’ve bought some real duds on Amazon, but this was not one of them. This has by far been one of my better purchases & I’ve told my kids that are planning to move to buy the bags too bc it is just so much easier imo.  I literally used a taxi to move half my stuff (disabled & don’t drive) & was able to fold the bags back down to how they arrived after unpacking to take them back to be packed again.  I also made little tags and used color coded handkerchiefs I hung on the handles so I knew which room the bags went in or knew what was in them without having to open them in the wrong room once I moved.  It saved time.  I live in an apt & these bags take up a lot less space than the massive sterling & Rubbermaid hard sided plastic totes I normally use for moving & craft storage.  I still have them & use them, but storing them is a challenge.  Also, the bags fit under my zinus/spa sensations type elevated platform bed. It’s a frame amazon sells & you buy your own mattress. Normally I can fit 8 hard sided tubs under my bed (queen bed), but I’m limited by the height of the tubs. The bags fit or I’m able to squish to fit if I overfill them which is nice.  Depending on how full you pack them you can get 4-8. They are different sizes than my plastic tubs tho.  I only wish I had stumbled across these bags years ago given how many times I’ve moved. Lol.

title: Lid very loose- needs a gasket imo. Small base.
text:
[[VIDEOID:c87e962bc893a948856b0f1b285ce6cc]] I wanted to love this bc I previously bought a matching turquoise teapot, but the loose lid (defective or design flaw? Idk) on the cups is driving me batty. I’m disabled so my gait is not great to begin with & the lid just bangs non-stop while I walk from my kitchen to wherever I’m going with my tea. It’s incredibly annoying. I had hoped it was just a one-off so I purchased it in another color & sadly it has the same exact problem. They could fix the problem by adding a rubber gasket or flange to the lid imo & I even thought of doing so myself until I accidentally knocked the cup over due to a design flaw that has a small base on the cup. I like the lid bc I run a fan continuously & I live with 2 service dogs so I like to keep my drinks covered beyond just the brew times so I really hope they update this cup bc it does keep the tea warm & the size is perfect for a 2 cup brew.

I wish they would fix the obvious design flaw of the base that is too small for a cup that tall & wide bc it is also very easy to accidentally knock over as I mentioned above. I did it several times before I yet boxed them both back up.

Overall I like the product as it seems as it was made with quality in mind, but missed the mark in the design phase. The colors are pretty & the cups I purchased keep the tea warm, but the lids are either defective or a design flaw. I really hope the company fixes these issue bc the colors match teapots I already own. Lol. I intend to see if the company has another design that works better for me in the meantime.

title: Best purchase ever!
text: If you live at a higher elevation like me (5k Colorado) just know that after the buzzer beeps you might wanna leave the hard boiled eggs inside the steamed cooker for another minute or two if you want the egg cooked all the way through. I also add a bit more water than the fill line says, but again that’s bc of my elevation & it evaporates quickly.  It’s not any quicker than I used to make them, but it’s a lot less water. I’m disabled & have a TBI rn so the auto-cutoff was a no-brained for me. I bought the blue bc it was cheapest.  My service 🐶  🐶 love hard boiled eggs too so we are enjoying this new addition to our kitchen.  My only regret is that I did not buy it sooner & that Amazon never has the color I want for the cheapest price, but I can live with the bb blue.  We have used it 3x & so far it’s working okay. Oh- don’t place it under upper cabinets as it has a vent hole & it will vent & it will make the cabinets sweat.  Give it some room to breathe imo.  I keep a pair of tongs handy to unload the eggs & dunk them in my ice bath. Yes. You end up using water again, but I have house plants I’ll use it on anyways so it not just wasted water.  If it holds up & doesn’t break down it will truly be one of my top 10 if not top 5 amazon lifetime purchases.  It’s that good.  Nothing is worse than watching eggs boil. Lol.  I start this up at the same time I start my tea brewing and go about feeding the wildlife in my backyard.  It’s just a very peaceful start to my day. I know ppl have said stuff about the buzzer, but honestly I happen to be hearing impaired in both ears & my service dogs are trained to hear for me. I like that it’s loud enough that if my pups are outside & I am in my living room or just outside on my patio with them & my screen door is open then they & often I can still hear it.  I wish appliances had volume options on their alarms, but until then I am very happy with this one.  I am just extremely happy with this purchase. It’s been a long time since I could say that. Lol.

title: Reduced 5 stars to 1
text: Dryer/Fire risk!  Previously  I wrote a lovely glowing review for this comforter.  Even tho it is a comforter I had covered it with a cotton duvet cover so this is the first time since my purchase that I have washed and tried to dry it. Per the website and the label I put in my dryer on the “low” setting. 3 minutes later while loading my washing machine a foot away I smelled something burning.  Too late I realized it was my comforter!  It’s also stuck to the inside of my dryer.  I’m a disabled veteran and I live on a fixed income so losing a purchase like this hits my pocket book pretty hard.  It is snowing in Colorado today or I would have hung this to dry, but alas I followed the seller’s website instructions and their label on the comforter.  Sadly, I see no warranty information at all.  The comforter was lovely. If you buy it do not try to dry it as per the instructions!

title: So matcha disappointment
text: I bought this after reading a TON of reviews about different milk frothers/steamers so I could make at-home matcha lattes with oat milk. I settled on the Froth Labs frother/steamer after reading a blogger's post about this item and was initially so thrilled with it - but it stopped frothing and steaming the milk after a month. Instead, it just heated up the milk. I returned the item to Amazon, thinking this was probably just a one-off thing, and it was promptly replaced by another. Which just stopped working after 2 months. And then I started reading all the reviews by people having the same exact problem. Fortunately, Amazon refunded me the cost of it even though it was a week past its return-by date. Buyer beware! This is an expensive purchase for something that that might work for a couple of months - and I used mine just once per day, unplugging it every time between uses, and using exactly as instructed. *Sigh* now I am back on the hunt for a reliable frother/steamer.

title: Broke with light use
text: I bought these chairs in April 2020. Easy to assemble and very pretty. However, one of the legs broke in August 2020 after light use by one person (my husband) who weighs well beneath the weight limit specified for the chairs. He was able to rig the broken leg for a couple months but it just broke again. I contacted the company who told me the chair is out of warranty, and further, they do not have replacement legs in stock even for purchase. There is no reason at all this chair should have broken the way it did, but after reading several other reviewers' issues, I realize this is not an isolated problem. Would not recommend these to anyone unless you don't plan to sit on them.

title: Great bar stools!
text: These stools (we purchased the cherry color) are definitely worth the effort of assembling them! My husband, who's the pro in our house at putting together our impulse-buy Ikea finds, assembled both of these stools in about 1.5 hours. He said some of the legs were not properly labeled according to the instruction manual, and screwing the cross-pieces onto the legs was somewhat awkward. I don't think I would have had the patience for it, haha. However, once assembled (see pics) the stools were perfect! The cushions are comfortable, and the cross-pieces on the stool legs are the perfect place to rest your feet. All four legs of each stool sit flush to the floor with no rocking or unsteadiness. One of the reasons I liked these stools over other options is because there are no buttons or other studs that could be broken, pulled, or chewed off. Ha! I almost took off a star for the assembly process, but in the end, they're such great, solid stools that I'm sticking with 5 stars.

title: Perfect for everything - minus stud earrings. :-)
text: I was really excited about this jewelry rack, and I couldn't have been more thrilled to see it hung on the wall. (Yep, hubs took care of that part. :-)) I researched quite a few storage solutions for jewelry and found several valet/racks that might fir the bill, but this one seemed to have the most versatility in terms of storage of different kinds of jewelry (bracelets, dangle earrings, long and short necklaces, hair ties, etc.) I love that the lower round racks actually spin in a circle  - great for storing long necklaces & for easy access! I use one of the upper horizontal bars to store my hair bands to keep the cats from getting them. The mesh screen is perfect for dangle earrings. I ALMOST gave this 4 stars instead of 5 because there is no solution for stud earrings. The designers thought of everything else but a tray that could hold miscellaneous baubles & earrings with posts. My solution to this was that I hung a small jewelry pouch from the valet and stored those earrings inside the pouch. It means I have to go rooting through the bag a lot, but really this jewelry valet is just perfect for storing everything else and it looks so cute on the wall. Since I really love it I decided to give it 5 stars, since it does exactly what it's advertised to do. My friends always compliment it and it's helped to keep me MUCH more organized. I posted a picture for you with all my stuff on it so you can see how I've organized everything. Good luck and I hope you like it as much as I do!

I think the only downside to this product, if you can consider it a downside, is that since the carafe is so...well....ROUND, you have to tip it almost completely upside-down to pour out the last of the coffee. It doesn't spill or anything, it's just a little...awkward. Hence the removal of the 5th star on the review. If you can deal with the slightly awkward pouring of the carafe, then you have yourself a sleek and winning coffeepot that does what it promises - brews a heavenly cup of joe. Enjoy! title: It works.
text: I wanted a small, inexpensive entryway shoe rack, and that's what I received. It's not the best quality, and the cubbies are very small, but it works for what I wanted. However, I knew this from previous reviews, and was OK with it. It's not worth a 5-star review, but since I knew what to expect, I wasn't really disappointed with it either. If you want something more sturdy (aka made out of real wood) and with better "shoe holes", you will pay more for it. If you don't have a gajillion large pairs of shoes, this product will probably work fine for you. I can fit 2 pairs of my size-6 summer sandals/flip flops in one cubby. title: Best Incense EVER. Hands-down. If You Like Rose.
text:
The first time I ever smelled this incense over ten years ago, I was at a guided meditation and felt transported to another realm. The scent is truly beautiful and attracts high vibrational energy. I had been looking for it since, then gave up.

Then I found it here. Can I tell you when that Amazon box came, you would think it was a baby puppy.

And it was everything I remembered. Two days later I brought it for a guy friend to experience and the reaction was, "WOW. I would have to say this is my new favorite incense, too."

It does have a very strong rose absolute oil scent with a hint of wood/cedar, or that's what it seems like to me. So if you don't like rose, don't do it. But if you've ever tried Stella McCartney's signature purple bottle perfume at Sephora when it came out almost a decade ago and liked that, you will LOVE this incense. Don't get me wrong, this scent is not feminine.

It is divine.

title: Bed is Very Comfortable, for a marshmallow!
text: When I ordered this mattress, I thought it was a medium firm, turns out it's a medium plush!!  Be careful reading the description of the mattress.  We needed a medium firm bed due to health issues. Easier to get out of a firm bed than a marshmallow.  Even sitting on the edge of the bed, was a nightmare. Unless you planted your feet firmly on the floor you were going to slide off the mattress. Plush is nice for snuggly sleepers. We are not!  This was bed #2 in a list of 4 beds we tried out before we finally got it right.  Shopping online is nothing new, but you can't sit on the bed and feel the firmness or plush featured on your mattress. In the same breath, getting out right now under the virus threat is very scary!!  Key words for mattress purchase?  Soft, plush, medium plush or medium firm.  Trial and error even online!

title: Keeps ingredients separate, high quality build, recommended
text:
When I got this I immediately tested it and made a salad to store in the fridge overnight, then shook the container a bit to test how well it separated things and ate it the next day. Nothing leaked and the plate kept the greens and the toppings from mixing so nothing got soggy. It was also easy to clean. The build seems very sturdy and high quality, I would buy this again or recommend it. The silicone gasket is easy to remove, clean, and replace. The included dressing cup is a good size and did not leak, but does not have a gasket, just a cap that screws on tightly. Because the materials in this container are on the thicker side and seem very sturdy, I don't anticipate any issues with leaks.

It's probably good for storing pasta dishes as well but it's especially good for salads because it keeps the ingredients separate. I was able to fit about 3 cups (60g) of greens which is enough for a fairly large salad! I think the manufacturer did a good job of making this large enough to fit a large, filling dish but not so large that it's hard to store or transport. I bought this to take to my office for lunches.

title: Great kettle!
text: I haven't owned this long enough to see if it holds up over time, but so far I really love it. title: Fantastic looking - descriptions are accurate.
text: Unit arrived on-time, the packaging was crushed on at least 2 sides. I was nervous, but there were firm corner supports and the unit was set back from the edges and undisturbed.  Installation was accompanied with an exterior support; just as a precautionary measure.  I chose to skip the side skirts and carved out an exact cut-out of the unit into 1/2" plywood; approx 12"x18".  I covered the plywood with white paneling and trimmed with matching corner round for a finished look.  The appearance is both stealth and rich.  The remote did not work. (I suspect battery).  The app worked great; so I use it exclusively for now.  It is somewhat louder than expected, but my wife enjoys the distraction, and this is in our sunroom - so it's not that big a deal.  The eco mode setting on restart is apparently Gov. required.  I'm not really interested in what the temp setting is; I just lowered until I was comfortable and use that as my baseline.  Overall, so far it's met our expectations.  Would have been higher rating if it was slightly quieter with a working remote, but the apps work just fine on ipad, iphone and Android devices especially the ability to program on and off settings, or remotely control the unit while away.

title: Received as gift.
text:
I saw this vacuum and it's good reviews. I decided I would love to have one to vacuum my stairs. I put it on my Amazon wish list. My sister purchased it as a gift for me. It stayed in its box for over a month. I finally took it out today to use it for the first time.

It is lightweight and easy to assemble. I took it to my staircase and proceeded to try it out. I had to re-vacuum my stairs after using it. It has very little suction. It doesn't hawve a brush to sweep up hair, lint, etc. It is useless on carpet. I would return it; however, since it has been over 30 days, I am unable.

I don't believe it would even work on upholstery. I couldn't use it on my area rug. I do have hardwood floors, but I didn't try it on them. I don't vacuum my hard floors, I sweep them.

I would definitely consider this vacuum a fail. I wouldn't recommend it at all!

text: This is a great decorating package of Oktoberfest decorations. I cannot wait to put it out next month during my family Oktoberfest party planned for mid-month. Colorful and well made, this is a great value priced package. I particularly like the balloons and banners. Great way to be able to make your home festive!

title: Great for all your food storage needs!
text: These are really nice quality food storage containers. There are a variety of shapes and sizes which makes it nice for all your storage needs. The tops fit snugly and air tight and help keep food fresher longer. I use the smaller one for taking my lunch to work in and it fits great in my large purse and I have no fear of leaking. This would make a great housewarming or bridal shower gift.

title: Where have you been all my life?
text: I typically, when icing a cake, have used a basic knife. Usually, the coating is jagged and I miss a lot of spots (plus the knife pulls out limited amounts from my icing tub). This handy tool is something I never thought I needed, but somehow now I find it almost irreplaceable. First, it fits well in my hand for easy maneuvering. Then it manages to get a solid amount of icing out of the tub and allows me to evenly spread it all over my cakes. I find the cakes come out almost flawless and it takes me a lot less time to complete than it did when I was using a knife. This would make an excellent add-on shower gift for the bride who has everything.

title: Great knife for the money!
text: This is a really nice knife. Quality made, for the money you can't go wrong. Cuts through vegetables easily and flawlessly. This knife also fits well in my hand and makes cooking prep a breeze. This knife also comes in a nice box so it would be perfect for gift giving (think bridal shower or housewarming present). I highly recommend this Konoll knife to every household!

title: For the money, these are nice
text: Have I had better pillowcases and sheets? Yes. But these are very nice, soft, not the highest quality but for under $15 they are great for me to switch to mid week (without having to wash the entire sheet set). These are soft, 400 thread count and a nice quality made sheet (has held up nicely to at least 4 washes already). Like I said, these are nice to have as a spare set. Highly recommend!

title: Every chef needs one of these!
text: I have been using this as a dough cutter for about a month now. I love to bake and make my own crusts, so I like to make a lot at one time and freeze the extra. This pastry cutter is great. It fits well in my hand and maneuvers easily. Cuts and presses the dough flawlessly. Clean up is also a breeze. Highly recommend!

title: Every kitchen should own one!
text: First, I really like Maison Huis kitchen products and own several of their devices. This garlic press is incredible and an excellent time and mess saver. In the past I would peel cloves and then chop them up into tiny pieces for my dishes. It sometimes could be painstakingly long to do, especially if the recipe called for 8+ cloves. This hand tool cuts the time by 75%+ and makes peeling and crushing/cutting garlic a breeze. Clean up is a breeze and I just pop it into the dishwasher and it comes out looking like new. This would make an excellent add on present for a bridal shower or home warming gift.

title: Great set with everything you need!
text: This is a slick bartender set at a great price. I was looking for something to use in my new bar area and this certainly fits the bill. Contains everything you need to make the perfect drink. I think this would make a great gift for a bridal shower or even a housewarming gift because it is unique and practical. I love the wood base as well that makes storage a breeze (and it looks great in my home). Highly recommend!

title: Every kitchen should own one of these!
text: This is a great little device. Makes cutting and serving pizza a breeze. Sometimes pizza cutting can be tricky but this tool does it all. I can cut the slices and then serve the slices in one step and I love it. This is also easy to clean up and I drop it into the dishwasher after use and it comes out looking like new. I could also see using this on cutting pies and cakes as well.This would make a cool and unique add-on bridal shower or new homeowner gift.

title: Best mattress protector on the market!
text: This is a really nice fabric protector. First, it fits my deep pocketed mattress perfectly and is not baggy or loose. Second, it is super soft and makes sleeping easy (with no 'crunching' vinyl noises when turning). Most importantly, it's a great protector. Within a week of my putting on the bed, one of my children spilled juice on my bed. I was able to quickly strip the bed to put everything in the wash and the mattress was just perfect. Washing the protector was easy and putting it back on the bed went flawlessly. Highly recommend!

title: Great mattress protector!
text: This is a really nice queen mattress protector. I have larger/deeper mattresses and had no trouble with this fitting my bed. Fits snugly and is water proof to help protect the mattress and it is super soft to the touch. The beige colors blends with my sheets well. No complaints, very happy with the quality.

title: Traditional peeler
text: This is a traditional peeler, easy to use on fruits and vegetables. It fits well in my hand and is sharp enough to easily remove the skin/peel off of fruits and vegetables (I used this on potatoes and apples in the last 3 weeks). Very well made and fits well in my hand. Would make a great add-on item for a bridal shower or housewarming gift.

title: Great soft pillowcases!
text: I got these pillowcases in a King size smoke gray color. These are super soft and well made pillowcases. They are also super soft which makes them great to sleep on. Don't really have anything negative to say, I did order another full set in white because I liked them so much. Highly recommend.

title: Nice shag bathroom rug!
text: I really like this Ouka bath mat. It is soft and plush and I love the old school shag feel to it. The blue color is a deep color and blends perfectly in my guest bath. I have washed it only once since I had it, I did it separately just because of the dark blue color. It did not fade and looks as vibrant as it did when I took it out of the bag. Nice inexpensive rug for a great look and feel.

title: Sometimes old school is better!
text: I used to use can openers like this back in the day and eventually started using electric ones. Although they are convenient, they take up valuable counter space and I eventually went back to the old standard. I really like this one. The turn handle is larger, makes it super easy to turn and the cut is clean and quick. This is a great multi-function gadget, I think it would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift add-on.

title: Where have you been all my life????
text: My household drinks quite a bit of wine and one of the chores we hate the most is opening the bottle. I had never tried an electric opener before. This is a great device, right out of the box it is ready to go. Opens a bottle with a quick touch of a button. I will never go back to manually opening a wine bottle again (of course unless it is a screw cap, lol). Highly recommend to all. Comes in great packaging and would make a great unique gift for the wine lover in your life.

title: Great way for the little ones to get in the Easter spirit!
text: These are super cute Easter window decorations. I had my two young grandsons over a couple of weeks ago and the three of us had a lot of fun decorating my window and door glass with these. They apply easily and just as easily they come off (which makes it a great way for my grandsons to change their designs easily. And, when the holiday was over, I easily removed them from my windows. This is a great, inexpensive way to decorate your home. Highly recommend!

title: Great colorful decorations that are easy to put up and take off
text: These are super cute St. Patrick's Day window decorations. I had my two young grandsons over a couple of weeks ago and the three of us had a lot of fun decorating my window and door glass with these. They apply easily and just as easily they come off (which makes it a great way for my grandsons to change their designs easily. And, when the holiday was over, I easily removed them from my windows. This is a great, inexpensive way to decorate your home. Highly recommend!

title: Nice non-stick whisk for every kitchen!
text: I really, really like this whisk. Super light in my hands, it makes mixing a breeze. The fact that it is silicone means that it' s non-stick properties allow food and batter to wash off easily. This has a real stainless steel look and blends with all the other utensils in my kitchen. This is a great device and every home and chef should have one. Highly recommend!

title: Great stainless steel flask
text: This is a really nicely made flask. Silver color, doesn't tarnish (I have put it through the dishwasher twice already). Holds liquids well, no leaks. If you are in the market for a quality made flask at a very reasonable price this is a great choice to make. Highly recommend!

title: Really nice tumbler, great for the gym or in the car!
text: This is a great tumbler. I live in a golf cart community in Florida and I love to have a 'beverage' when I am driving around. This tumbler is well made and does not leak no matter how much the cart bounces. It is easy to clean, I just open it up and put it in the dishwasher top and all. I love the dark blue color as well as it blends with my cart as well. Whether I want something cold or hot, this tumbler maintains the temperature of the liquid well. Highly recommend for anyone!

title: Nice attractive utensil holder
text: This is an attractive utensil holder, beautiful blue color it matches my decor perfectly. Looks like it is well made, I love the finish on the outside which makes it easy to clean if any grease splashes. If I had any complaints at all it's that I wish it had a wider circumference to fit all of my utensils (I ended up putting several in one of my kitchen drawers as they wouldn't fit.. But, it is really nice and definitely adds to the look of my kitchen.

title: Great placemats, gives your table the great holiday feel!
text: These are the cutest placemats ever for the holidays. I have a small round table off of my kitchen that has 4 chairs and it's amazing how festive these mats made that area look! Colorful, well made and I love the red and white colors. The plaid is great too and just adds to the holiday feeling. Highly recommend for all homes to add to your holiday decorations!

title: A great chef's knife for the money!
text: I love to cook and I own a large variety of knives in my kitchen. I wasn't sure what to expect for this price, but I honestly was pleasantly surprised. First, it comes in a nice box, great for gift giving (bridal shower, housewarming, Christmas). Second it's attractive and unique with it's design. And lastly, it fits well in my hand (ergonomic) and slicing vegetables and meats is a breeze. This knife is sharp and durable and makes a great addition to any kitchen. Highly recommend!

title: Great all use spatula
text: This is a really nice, reasonably priced, spatula. Well made and very heat resistant. I have used it in my kitchen with my frying and crepe pans and I have also used it for turning hamburgers on the grill with no problem or 'melting' of the rubber. It is a nice size as well, easy to store and washes well in the dish washer. Highly recommend.

title: Great way to get holiday spirit!
text: This is a super cute way to decorate for the holidays. I put these in the windows (including the front door glass) and it makes the house look so cute from the outside. Being that I live in Florida, I love the snow flakes adorning the glass. These are easy to apply and easy to remove. Highly recommend as a cheap addition to adding holiday accents to your home.

title: Nice holiday pillow covers for my home!
text: These are cute pillow covers for the holidays. They are a darker blue, matches my decor perfectly and definitely helps add to the spirit of the holidays in my home. Not the softest of material, but they fit a standard pillow perfectly and zip up easily. Quality made, too. Highly recommend.

title: Nice quality heat resistant tongs, work perfectly!
text: These are great heat resistant tongs. I have been using them on my grill and just this past weekend used them to flip some ribs and chicken. No melting of the silicone, stood up well. I also love the red design as it matches my kitchen decor perfectly. This tool is well made (quality), fits great in my hand and maneuvers easily. It should stand up to years of use (with a little care).

title: Great vacuum sealer, easy to use and saves food
text: This is a great vacuum sealer machine. I use it every time I grocery shop at Sam's Club and buy a package of steaks, chops and or chicken. I seal portion sizes easily and flawlessly and am able to freeze foods without getting freezer burn on the meats. This was much easier to use than I thought it would be and if I can use this, anyone can. Great way, especially for single homeowners like myself to make meals and portions easily (also helps with keeping my caloric intake under control). Highly recommend to all.

title: Versatile well made, attractive pie dish!
text: I have used this pie dish several times since I have received it. First, I just made a couple of apple pies last week and one of them was in this beautiful red ceramic dish. I also used it when making a chicken pot pie last Sunday. I had friends over and several recommended what an attractive dish this is. Almost all my countertop accessories are red, so this pie dish blended right in. Quality made, relatively heavy and super easy to clean. This would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift, or just to treat yourself. Highly recommend.

title: Just what I was looking for!
text: I have been looking for a new paring knife for some time now. When I saw this, I had never heard of the KBK brand so I wasn't sure what to expect. Last weekend I decided to make some apple pies and thought I could put it to good use. This unit fits great in my hand and makes it super easy to maneuver around the fruit. The blade is sharp and the skin came off almost in one complete slice. I also used this on some roasted potatoes I was making with the same result. I highly recommend this paring knife. Would also make a great bridal shower or new home party gift. Highly recommend.

title: A must have for every kitchen!
text: This is just what I was looking for for my kitchen. It is a nice size and clings nicely to my quartz countertop. I can wash loads of dishes and place them to drain on this mat. Water rolls off easily and dishes dry quickly. When I am entertaining I simply roll up the mat and store it. Highly recommend, especially the grey color as it seems to blend with most kitchen decors.

title: Great table napkins, great color!
text: These are really nice table napkins for the money. Full size and absorbent, they work well for guests and family to use at meal time. The color (I received the grey) will blend with most decors and goes great in my dining room (mostly blue). Highly recommend this Whitewrap brand if you are in the market for new table napkins.

title: Great quality lunch bag for all ages!
text: Super cute and colorful, this is a great insulated lunch bag. Lots of room for a can of soda, sandwich and salad, this bag can be used by young and old alike, male or female. Quality made, solid zipper, this bag will last for years. I also love the shoulder strap which makes it easy for me to bring with me (especially when I have a purse and a laptop to carry). Highly recommend this bag for everyone (and it comes in several colors, I have blue and it's beautiful and easy to find if I put it in the office refrigerator).

title: Great looking and functional lunch cooler/bag
text: Great bag to take to school or the office. Nice size with compartments. Fashionable (I got the red color) and fits easily under my desk. I packed lunch and a bottle of water and everything stayed cool and fresh for the 5 hours it was under my desk (insulated well). I even took this to the beach last weekend for a day out and everything surprisingly stayed cool there as well. Highly recommend for either kids for school, adults for office or even to the beach or park to keep foods cool.

title: This toaster oven does it all!
text: Really nice toaster oven. I had never heard of this brand before and since it had an air fryer option I was anxious to try it. Great size, enough room for a small chicken or pizza. Well made, silent and clear and large led display. I did have some confusion doing the original set up (clock for example) but once I read the manual, I had no problems. The air fryer works great and I used it the second day I had it with some chicken I was making. Chicken came out crispy and there was no mess. Quick and easy. This would make a great housewarming/bridal shower gift for someone or just as an option to replace an older unit you already own. Highly recommend!

title: Best insulated tumbler on the market!
text: I live in a golf cart community in Florida and I had been looking for some kind of insulated cup to be able to use both in my cart, to take to the gym or even just laying out by the pool in the hot Florida sun. I love this cup. It keeps my beverages cool (it takes a while for the ice cubes to even start to melt), it's a great size and holds a lot, and my drinks taste fresh and clean. I pop this in the dishwasher (along with the cap and straw) and it comes out sparkling clean. Highly recommend this insulated cup.

title: Colorful way to show your American pride!
text: This was a great set to help decorate my golf cart for the local 4th of July golf cart parade. Lots of colorful patriotic items which actually are pretty well made. This is perfect for my cart, the little flags look great along the sides. The lanterns are really cute too.

title: Fantastic pillow! Best I have ever used.
text: I absolutely love this pillow. I have suffered from neck and shoulder pain for most of my life and have tried all kinds of pillows to aid in my sleep. This inflatable cervical adjustable pillow is fantastic. With a touch of a button I can adjust the volume and get the optimum sleep support that I need. Material is super soft and cushiony but it gives me the support I need. I wish it wasn't made in China (prefer to buy American) but this pillow is definitely one of the best I have ever tried.

title: Great storage and attractive too!
text: These are beautiful storage containers. I have them on my kitchen counter and I keep spaghetti, rigatoni, coffee and sugar in them. Such a convenient and attractive way to keep foods handy, fresh and always at your disposal. These also come in a nice box to they would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift to someone. You could also use these and fill with colorful pebbles or candies to add color to any decor, so I have already ordered another set to sit out on a shelf in my living room. I highly recommend these.

title: Great sheets, fits perfect and is super soft!
text: This is a really nice deep pocketed sheet set. I got a queen size and it fits my bed perfectly. I have washed this set twice since I have received it and the gray color is still vibrant and the sheets are virtually wrinkle free. These sheets are super soft and luxurious and I have already purchased a set for my son and daughter in law because I was so impressed. Spoil yourself (at a reasonable price) and buy a premium set of sheets for an optimal night's sleep. Highly recommend!

title: Wonderful humidifier, works great and I sleep much better now!
text: I have been using this Vick's humidifier almost nightly since I received it. Normally my bedroom, especially this time of the year is dry and cold and I wake up with a semi sore throat. Given that I also suffer from allergies. I rarely get a good night's sleep because my nasal passages also fill up overnight. Since I have been using this,  I awake refreshed and my throat is clear and not raw. I have not used this with Vicks Vaporub in the device yet, but I can definitely see where this will be my definitive go to when I catch my next cold. My room is 16X20 and I keep the device on my nightstand for optimal impact. Highly recommend.

title: Great seat covers!
text: I really like these. I have been using them every Sunday since I received them for when my son and his family come to visit. My current dining room set (less than a year old) has beige seat cushions which are an open invitation for my two grandsons to make a mess during meal time. I have been using these covers for their chairs and set up and clean up is a breeze. I just throw them in the washer to clean them after use. They also look great and I just ordered another set (since I have 6 seats) to use as a means to switch up my decorating from time to time. Really highly recommend them.

title: One of the best chef knives on the market today!
text: I love to cook and I am always in the market for knives. This Wallop Damascus Santoku Knife is just perfect. For under $80 (which was the price when I was reviewing this), this knife is as good as the multi-hundred dollar+ competitor knives. First, it a perfect fit in my hand which allows me to maneuver the knife around my vegetables smoothly and flawlessly. Second, it is super sharp and slices through tomatoes and onions flawlessly. I can honestly say this is one of the finest chef knives I have ever used and I highly recommend this knife for anyone who loves to prepare and cook. This also makes a great gift with it's attractive packaging and would be a wonderful, thoughtful, shower, wedding or homeowner present for the person you love!

title: Super fun and easy to set up and use!
text: This is a cute gadget for the person who has everything! Easy to add batteries and easy to use, this would make a great gift during the holidays. No more messing around with manual screwing bottle openers, this makes opening a wine bottle super easy. I have some fingers which are arthritic and this opener makes the chore a simple pleasure. I highly recommend this opener for everyone!

title: Not just for Christmas!
text: These are really nice, full size pillow covers. I put them on some existing throw pillows I had on my off white living room couch to change it up for Christmas. However, after having them on there for a couple of weeks now, I will probably keep them on long after the holidays. Solidly, quality made, great muted colors (not super bright red), they look great. I highly recommend these for all uses and all times of year.

title: A real easy way to take care of your plants when you are away
text: This is a great way to maintain my Florida lanai plants when I am away. I travel often (either for business, visiting family or just taking a cruise). I am so glad I found these so I no longer have to ask (beg) a neighbor to come over and water the plants when I am gone. I use a slow drip on my Christmas cactus plant and a faster drip on my pathos vines, it's nice being able to control the release. Now I have to figure out if I can use these when I go for three weeks in October to visit some friends, but even if they are only good for two weeks it's an amazing aid. Easy to set up, easy to use, highly recommend!

title: Good quality, reasonably priced desk/table
text: This Decoholic computer desk is surprisingly nice for the money. Nicely made, good quality and super easy to put together (took me about 10 minutes and I am usually technically challenged when it comes to this stuff). Super functional, nice size, it can be used as a desk or even as just a place to showcase items in your home. I already had a desk in my home (one with drawers) and I am using this as a place to put my printer. Highly recommend!

title: Great smaller size bakeware, perfect for quiches
text: I love Chefmade products and have a lot of their baking dishes in my kitchen. This 7 inch tart pan is great. Well made, sturdy and easy to use, I can make a quiche or a small cheesecake easy with the removable bottom. Really nice looking to, it would make a great extra gift for a bridal shower (a size and type of kitchen accessory that may not be typical but truly will be one of the most used items in their kitchen). Really nice, highly recommend.

title: What great food storage containers! I love them!
text: I really love these! First they are relatively heavy (glass) and super durable. I love that I can make a meal, store it in the container, freeze it and then place it in the oven or microwave when I am ready to eat it.  These are dishwasher safe, seal perfectly and are now one of my most used items daily in my busy home. I highly recommend these to everyone who needs a quick easy way to store meals. Whether you want to use these strictly in your kitchen or carry them to work or school with meals these are perfect. Would also make a great gift during the holidays for the person in your life who has everything.

title: Great sleep topper which really makes a difference!
text: This is a really sweet mattress topper. First, it fits my larger depth guest bed nicely with the 15 inch deep pocket fit. Second, it is soft and cushiony and really makes a difference from sleeping on the mattress on it's own. Third, it washes easily and comes out of the wash looking like new. I have twin beds in my guest room, so I have two of these now and I have had a load of compliments on how soft and comfortable the beds are (while still maintaining support). I highly recommend this Sleep Mantra brand to use and improve your nightly sleep régime.

title: Nice way to store toys and other items around your house
text: Great, nice-sized (13.75x13.75x17) storage. I am using it in my home to hold my grandchildren's toys when they aren't visiting. It is well made, fairly light and easy to carry around when you need to move it from one place to another. If there is any downside at all (which is why I deducted a star) is that if you don't have it close to full it kind of crunches collapses in. I would have preferred a sturdier unit that could still collapse but have more support when open.

title: Great compact iron for many uses!
text: Very nice compact iron and with the name Proctor Silex you know you are getting a quality item. It's been years (seriously) since I had used an iron and when I saw this I wanted to try it.This little iron packs a punch and steams and dewrinkles everything. I have been using this weekly on shirts to get them crisp looking and is also small enough to take on a trip to help with wrinkled packed clothes. This is a staple in my house now and I am not sure what I have done without it before.

title: Hardly any fragrance, short burn time, didn't like
text: I was very disappointed with this candle. First, I burn candles all the time in my home (even leave a small tea light scented on in my bathroom when I am home for hours each day. When I saw this candle, I was really interested to try it as I have used Via Mercato items before (I love their liquid soaps) and I really like them. I won't go into too much detail here because many others have expressed the concerns I have. First, it's the amount of time you can burn this (one hour) is totally ridiculous. Second, I also don't like the way this burns (down the center). And last, but more importantly is the fragrance, there is barely any to discern (I had the Peach and Fig variety). Very disappointed and won't be buying again.

title: Beautiful real looking roses for your home!
text: These are much nicer than I was expecting. Perfect for my entrance way half table, these white roses look so realistic I have to do a double take when I pass by them. Beautiful white flowers, rich green leaves, quality made, they fit perfectly in my 12" vase. I have received many compliments on them since I start displaying them. Highly recommend!

title: Hours of fun!
text: I got these for my grandchildren for when they visited me in Central Florida this past July. What fun! These were safe enough to be able to throw around inside the house without damage to any of my knick-knacks or furniture. These look and feel (ok, not in temperature but texture) like real snowballs. My grandchildren are 6 and 4 years old and I actually bought another set and sent it to their home in California for them to play with when they are home. Highly recommend for good fun (without the damage).

title: Nice quality towels for your bath
text: I really liked this towel set. Well made, soft, absorbent, these towels are great. If there was anything to deduct a star for, it's for the 8 piece set. Typically, I use mostly bath towels and washcloths. In my opinion, this 8 piece set is a bit of overkill (and if I wanted a set of 4-6 of these, I wouldn't have the space for all of the sizes). Outside of that, these are great towels and can absorb a lot of water. They hold up well with repeated washings, too, with no fading. This rich pebble color is a great neutral one and will blend with most colors in your home. Highly recommend!

title: Fan works great, cools me in the Florida heat
text: This is a nice little handheld fan. I live in Florida where it is hot 9 months of the year and I honestly needed this. Perfect size, strong fan, it really packs a punch when I am at a theme park or at the beach. I am deducting one star simply because of battery life (I got half of what the item advertises. Outside of that, great little tool to keep in your car or bag to use when you need it. I assume it will come in handy as well when the next hurricane strikes (yike) and I lose power.

title: Great, powerful portable battery operated fan
text: This is a great rechargeable fan to keep for emergency uses or even to take if you are not anywhere near electricity. I live in Florida and with frequent lightning, I have had several occasions when I was without electricity. When I saw this fan I couldn't wait to try it. It is powerful and holds a charge for a long time. As we enter into hurricane season, this fan will be kept with the rest of my supplies to help if I lose power for a period of time. I also like this for use when we are out on my lanai in the heat to have the fan on helps with circulation and definitely brings the heat levels down. Highly recommend!

title: Great way to store your winter and not so often used things
text: I moved from NJ to FL about 3 years ago. Since I have been down here, I had a guest room closet which was filled with a lot of my winter stuff (jackets, snowsuit, sweaters, boots). When I saw these bags I thought I would try them as a way to ease up some space. These vacuum storage bags are amazing. I was able to condense almost all of my winter stuff in just one bag, which I was able to store under my guest room bed. I used another bag to store away some really nice down comforters I had brought down with me as well. These bags keep away moisture, and insects, and help minimize your space needs. I highly recommend these!

title: Nice quality comforter, works in both warm and cooler climates
text: Well made down comforter, perfect for any kind of weather. Although down does tend to be thought of for winter, I find it perfect year round. This is a soft comforter and I use it in my guest room with colorful pillow shams so the white is perfect for any room. I did deduct a star as it didn't seem as big as it should for a queen, I found the width of it to be a tad short on my bed (so I needed to pull it to one side a bit more so you couldn't see the mattress when entering the bedroom). Other than that, it's a nice quality comforter.

title: Wonderful way to enjoy your meals on the go!
text: Such a unique product! I typically bring lunch with me to work instead of buying it. Many times I have left overs (like yesterday I brought some meatloaf with me), but the sandwiches are cold by the time I get to eat them. Now with this little handy device I can plug in the bag about an hour before lunch and, presto, my lunch is warm and tasting fresh. I have already bought one for my son (who also brings his lunch/dinner with him on occasion) and will most likely give one as a gift this Christmas for a dear friend of mine up north. This is the kind of thing that would make a great gift for the person who has everything. Unique, classy and works!

title: Great small non-stick pan for muffins or candies
text: They call this a mini-muffin pan, but I think it is better for making candies (too small for muffins I like to make). Anyway, well made, beautiful color, easy to clean, this is a great cooking pan for any chef to have in their kitchen. A few of these in different sizes would make a great bridal shower gift to give to someone as unique gifts. Really loved this!

title: Nice old school style clock, alarm and radio
text: If you are in the market for an alarm clock, this Pingko is the way to go. I love the fact that I can have the display dim during the overnight hours so that it will not disrupt my sleep. This clock is visible from anywhere in the room and certainly makes seeing the time an easy thing to do. In this day and age where everyone is using their smart phones to alarm and tell time, this is so much easier (and old school) so you don't need to pick up anything to see the time. This would be great for traveling and I will take it on my upcoming cruise in August.

title: NIce, attractive pillow covers for your home
text: These are relatively inexpensive velour pillow covers. I use the on my white leather couch to add a pop of color to my family room. Soft and well made, the blue color is beautiful and vibrant. Normally, velour is not my go to fabric choice (reminds me of the 1970s) but these are pretty and will add a great dimension to your home.

title: Great space heater and overall circulating fan!
text: This is a really good room space heater and fan. I live in Florida and used it for a few weeks back at the end of April and now I am using for strictly room circulation/fan in my bedroom. With the constant storms we have down here in the late afternoons and evenings, the light whirring noise the fan makes helps to 'white noise' hide some of the thunderboomers too throughout the night (allowing me to sleep better). I really like this as my bedroom (which is 14x18 in size) gets full coverage from this unit. I highly recommend if you need a space heater or even just a fan for your room.

title: Beautiful blue soft fleece blanket
text: Super soft fleece blanket. I fold it and keep it over my family room couch and use it to drape it over myself when I am feeling cold. It is soft and pill free and is so comfortable. It looks super attractive, too, with a vibrant blue color. Of course, others may want to use this as a bed blanket, but as my bed is king size, this is far better used as an oversized throw. I absolutely love this.

title: Well made, easy to clean, great for candy making!
text: This is a great pan for making small cookies or candies. Heavy, well made and easy to clean, this is a great way to make smaller sized treats for your family and friends. I especially like this for chocolates and have made several batches already and clean up is a breeze (practically rinses clean without needing a sponge). I highly recommend this pan for you or the chef in your life. Keep in mind the size of the cookies/candies when selecting this pan.

title: Great closet organized, well made, looks great and works!
text: This was a god-send to me. I have a new home with a standard closet and I had pocketbooks and shoes all around with no place to store them. This is a great way to put all my pocketbooks into sleeves. I have them organized by colors and I was easily able to fit about 10 in here (could have done more if I wanted to stuff them). Very well made, comes fully assembled and within seconds you can begin to get your closet organized. Now all I have to do is find something similar for my shoes (I am researching now).

title: Really nice addition for any bedroom!
text: Very attractive, good quality, reasonably priced comforter/duvet cover. With matching pillowcases and a vibrant color,  this is an attractive addition to my guest bedroom. For less than $50, it's a great deal comparable to famous name-brand bed sets. I don't know what other reviewers had negative things to say, this is a great product for any home.

title: Great way to keep your silverware and utensils organized and available!
text: I live in a new subdivision in Florida where the neighbors get together all the time. Twice I have hosted events in my home and had to put my silverware out on a countertop. Not a great organized way to display the forks and knives and it actually took up a lot of unnecessary countertop space. When I saw this I wanted to see how it would work. Last weekend I used it for the first time and it was a huge success. First, it is attractive and blends easily with my brushed nickel sink and stainless steel appliances. Second, it is compact and takes up less space. And last, it has compartments for the various types of utensils (and keeps everything organized). I am thrilled to be using this and will continue to keep it in my kitchen pantry for future parties and events!

title: Best hand-held mixer on the market today!
text: This is a great hand mixer. I actually have only used mixers before for cake batters and whipping cream purposes. But with this B&D Performance Premium hand mixer, I find I can do much more. I used it most recently with making cookie dough for Christmas. I was amazed how easily this is to use and how well everything mixed. This fits well in my hand and I can control it well. The red color matches my other kitchen accessories so it looks great. This would make a great holiday gift or a wonderful bridal shower or house warming gift for someone you love. Modern, stylish and full functional for all your mixing needs.

title: Great tree skirt, inconvenient way to light
text: I need to start by saying I really am impressed with this skirt.  It is large and a beautiful red plaid color. I kind of like the faux fur (might be a tad gawdy). This is really well made and a quality item. I deducted one star because of the lights and the way they did the battery. I actually turn my lights on my tree remotely now, however with this skirt, I need to bend down, find the switch and turn it on and off. Anyway, I will only be lighting it on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day as it is too difficult to put the lights on the skirt. They really should have thought that through.

title: Great stockpot, perfect for everyone!
text: This is a great stockpot for the money. First, it is super attractive, well made and lightweight. I love this color, too, it blends with all my kitchen decor. I love Rachel Ray products as they always provide good products at reasonable prices. This 6 quart size is great for making pasta and soups. This would make an excellent bridal shower or housewarming present for anyone. Highly recommend!

title: Great pillow inserts!
text: This is a great, convenient, 4 pack of pillow inserts. I had bought some decorative sea life pillow covers that had been sitting in my linen closet for months now waiting for me to make my way to Michaels to buy inserts. I was thrilled to see that Amazon sells these, and a 4 pack is just what I needed. These are the right size (18"), well made, sturdy and fit inside my cases perfectly.  These are great for my living room set. Perfect!

title: Gorgeous new candle, looks wonderful in my home!
text: This is an absolutely beautiful decorative candle made by Yankee Candle. I absolutely love the shape and design and it looks really great in my contemporary leather living room. The fragrance is light, but fragrant and looks amazing when lit. I have been using it non-stop for the past week or so and it still looks like new. Nothing but great things to say about this candle!

title: Great indoor, relatively smokeless grill, but difficult to clean
text: I recently sold my house and moved into an apartment where I intend to stay for about three months until my new house is ready. I love to grill in my old house and new house I had And will use a gas grill.  I knew living in a strange place for a few months and being out of my regular routine, I would really miss the healthier meals that I would make. When I saw this Krupp’s grill, I was a little hesitant.  Currently living in an apartment, I didn’t want to have to worry about smoke detectors going off, or anything else that might impact the building on them. From a personal perspective, I was worried that I wouldn’t like the taste of the food given that I’m used to growing on outdoor grills. Boy, but what a mistake I made! This is an absolutely great grill. I found very little smoke and cooking hamburgers, and they tasted great. I even think they cooked more evenly then they would’ve on the grill.  My only complaint, and that’s why am removing one star, is the cleanup. I did line the pan with aluminum foil which did help. However the inside of the grill underneath the heating element. It’s very difficult to clean. With the splashing of grease from the burgers it did take me a while to try to get this clean, and I’m still not sure if it was 100% clean. I probably won’t be using this quite as often as I would have an outside grill, but in a pinch, this is a great grill to use indoors for an apartment or a home.

title: Great larger toaster oven, meets all my needs
text: I love this new toaster oven. Replacing a french door model that I had (not Hamilton Beach) this stove really gives me what I needed. Nice and large, I can cook a pizza or whole chicken easily (without having to fire up the oven). Food heats and cooks evenly. Heat does not escape the unit while cooking (unlike my french door model where if I run my hand in the front of the glass I can feel heat permeating the device). I love the digital display and the stainless steel finish matches all my kitchen appliances. I couldn't be happier.

title: A great addition to any kitchen, I couldn't think of an easier, tastier way to cook for my family
text: These are my absolute favorite items to keep in my kitchen pantry. I use my slow cooker at least 2-3 times a month and these liners make cleanup an absolute breeze. There is no easier way to cook on the planet besides using the cooker and the liners together. I was originally a little leery about using them, wondering if there would be any impact on the taste of the foods. But Reynolds truly knows how to make quality products that make our lives simpler and easier. If you are going to a bridal shower or a first time apt/homeowner, these would make a great gift (of course with a slow cooker).

title: A great new line of cookware from Calphalon, looks like I am going to be buying a whole new set!
text: I love Calphalon and have used their pots and pans exclusively over the past 10+ years. Quality products, durable and a great non-stick surface, Calphalon makes quality products that every chef loves to use. I was ecstatic to see this new space saving variety and, ugh, now I am hooked and will have to buy more of this line. I love the way this fits in my cabinet compactly and I will have to test how the matching set nests together to save space. I am tough on my cookware and use gas exclusively in my kitchen and Calphalon stand up to regular use and washes clean effortlessly. No complaints except now that I have used this 5 qt saute pan I will now have to invest and purchase the others in the line.

title: Grinder works well, peppercorns in a mid-courseness came out even and well ground
text: I have had several electronic salt and pepper shakers over the years. Overall they disappoint me and typically I revert back to the manual grinding ones. This  Cole & Mason Penrose peppermill is no exception. First, I couldn't get it open (even after reading the instructions several times). Granted, I am a 62 year old female and eventually asked my son to help. He struggled but eventually got it open. Then came the batteries (6? Isn't that crazy?). I used this for black peppercorns. It did grind well, and there were adjustable settings depending on how you like your courseness. Anyway, not much to say. It is a good mill, not sure how long the 6 batteries will last. If it turns out less than a month I will come back and update this with a three star review. I have had better, lesser expensive, less battery hungry models (and like I said, the manual grind work just as well). I give it 4 stars for the 'coolness' factor.

title: Great pot holders, durable and long lasting!
text: I love DII products. Usually very reasonably priced, the quality can't be beat. These pot holders are no exception. Well made, they stand up to heat easily to protect my hands from oven and bakeware. I have washed them once in my washing machine and they came out looking like they were new. I love this whole product line as the colors match flawlessly and make my kitchen look clean and fresh. These would make a great shower gift to give the new bride (or even home/apartment dweller) as a complete set for the kitchen. Can't go wrong, great price and quality!

title: Great device, I don't know how I lived without it all these years!
text: This is a neat little device. I used to use my garlic press, but no more. This helps me grate garlic into smaller slivers which seems to blend and cook better in my recipes. The most wonderful part of all is the cleanup. My garlic press seemed to leave more in the device than in my recipes and clean up was difficult getting it out of all the nooks and crannies. This garlic grater works cleaner and I get far more garlic in my dishes. I also like that I can slide or shred into different consistencies (depending on my recipe), something I would usually have to do with a knife. I couldn't be happier with this device and no kitchen should be without it. This would make a great little add on bridal shower gift (something unique and useful).

title: Great animal print cup cake cups!
text: These are super cute. I ordered them when I was making cupcakes for a preschool 'What animal would you like to be' party for my grandson. Colorful, different, unique. I love the fact that you can purchase theme-based baking cups like this. In addition to being unique, they are also practical and produce perfectly shaped cupcakes. Perfect for any stylized party needs you might have.

title: Great, quality wood salt and pepper shakers. Would look wonderful on any table in any home!
text: Quality made, attractive salt and pepper shaker. These make a great addition to any household and would make a terrific bridal shower or housewarming gift (or just a gift for yourself). I use these for more casual settings (although you could use them for everything) and I have received a load of compliments from family and friends on them since I started placing them on my table. On top of looking good, they perform excellently, grinding my peppercorns to perfection. I highly recommend them these to everyone who takes pride in how their table is set.

title: Great cast iron skillet, perfect for a single cook to use!
text: This is the first time I have ever used a cast iron stove top skillet and I have to say I am quite impressed. I had a rib eye steak that I was intending to use my gas grill for, but instead opted for my stove top. I am absolutely amazed at how evenly the steak cooked and I loved the grill marks that the grooves left on the steak (looks like it was grilled). In addition, I can see the health benefits of allowing the fat to stay away from the meat. Clean up was a relative breeze as well. If I had any complaints at all it would be in the size. This is a handy size for a single person to cook solo meals on. However, if I was looking to make pancakes for my grandkids, this would never be able to pass the test only cooking about 2-3 pancakes at a time. I am going to look for a larger version to keep around for weekend family meals.

title: Great, relatively light weight, versatile slow cooker!
text: Absolutely amazing slow cooker! This replaced a HB slow cooker I had for about 6 years. This model 33480 has all the bells and whistles the older model didn't have. I used to find with my older model that even on a low cook setting, my food was always getting cooked too high for the setting. This new Hamilton Beach has Low-High-Warm settings and is so easily programmable. I set my recent beef stroganoff to low for 8 hours and it came out absolutely flawless. I also had made some meatballs and sausage (cooked in a frying pan) and used this slow cooker at a Warm setting for about 2 hours. The meat stayed juicy and heated (but not overcooked). This unit also is lighter than my old unit and is smaller dimension-wise but is larger and holds far more. I couldn't be happier with this Hamilton Beach slow cooker!

title: Great powerful little fan!
text: Although I do camp on occasion, my primary reason for ordering this fan is for my life in Florida (and the many storms we have here). Last year when we had a super close threat of a Hurricane, I lost power for 1/2 a day. Luckily it was restored relatively quickly. Next time there is a storm like the cat 4 that just grazed us, I want to be better prepared. Heat in the summer here can be relatively unbearable without air conditioning. Needless to say, having a relatively mid-sized powerful fan that can be battery powered, can be a life saver if we lose power for one or more days. My only concern with this is the need for 8 batteries, but I purchased a 24 pack and will have it handy. In using this, I find the fan to be relatively powerful for it's size and I can use it easily in my bedroom to keep the air circulating. I am purchasing another as we speak so I will be better prepared overall. I am extremely happy with this fan and whether you are camping or preparing for a storm, this O2Cool fits the bill for preparedness!

title: Love this lightweight comforter! Ella Jayne is known for quality products!
text: Beautiful, well made, soft and plump with polyester fill, this comforter is a must have for any homeowner. I love the lightweight feel, yet it is amazingly warm and comfortable to sleep with. This is a high quality comforter which stood up to two machine washings since I have had it in the last month (using bulky bedding mode) and came out with no pulls or snarls. The stitching is strong and this should last for years in any household. I love Ella Jayne products and prefer them over other bedding brands because of the quality products they produce. This would make a great present for a bride or a first time homeowner.

title: Great chair, difficult (for me) to assemble
text: Great looking chair at a very reasonable price (compared from what I can get a chair for at Office Depot). It is comfortable and stylish. Wheels and adjustable height makes this a great chair for maneuvering in a tight space (think dormitory). I am deducting a star because, as a 60 year woman who is typically competent at putting things together, found it difficult to assemble. I ended up having my nephew come over to help me. Maybe you won't have any issues, just if you are strong it might be a lot easier than it was for me. Overall, happy with the chair and I would recommend. Would make a great chair for a kid going away to school due to its price and size.

title: Great quality! Great size! A must have for every kitchen!
text: I love Calphalon products and use them almost exclusively in my kitchen. Sure, they are expensive. But when it comes to quality and durability, Calphalon can't be beat. It is truly the old adage 'You get what you pay for' applies when shopping for your kitchen. This large stock pot is beautiful and stands up to my tough cooking (I have a tendency to stir and use items in the pots that I probably shouldn't). I have even run this through the dishwasher a few times and it comes out looking like new. This is a great size for cooking soups and pasta. Would make a great bridal shower present for the bride who has all the basics, to help expand her kitchen ware. It also would make a great 'not so new' homeowner or renter to just help make their kitchen complete (think holiday shopping). I love this Signature series!

title: Unattractive and no functionality. Why buy?
text: Guess I really don't understand the purpose of this. It isn't that attractive and takes up space on my countertop with no functionality. When trying to take out sheets of paper towels, you need to hold the roll and yank down. It is far easier for me to just hold the roll of paper towels in my hand and tear off what I need. On top of it, it doesn't even look good on my countertop (and cheaply made). I inserted a half full roll and it looked lost in this holder. Anyway, it is off my countertop as it doesn't add anything to my kitchen.

title: Love this toaster oven - perfect for my needs
text: Beautiful toaster oven. I love that the door swings up instead of down (like my previous one). Makes it so much easier to remove food without burning my hands. Matches my stainless steel kitchen perfectly. The digital display looks terrific too. Great cooking size, I easily can cook a pizza or even a small roasting chicken with ease. Food cooks quickly and is evenly distributed. I love that for smaller meals I don't need to turn on my full size oven. No complaints, great device if you are looking for a new one for your kitchen.

title: I am in love with a soap dispenser!
text: Beautiful soap dispenser. Matches perfectly in my Moen brushed nickel fixtures bathroom. Larger than I was expecting, I think I would have liked it a tad smaller (just because I feel I may have to keep it filled up most of the time because of it's crystal clear see-through glass), but outside of that it's perfect. Well made construction, pumps perfectly and beautifully smooth in design. No complaints, just wonderful for any brushed nickel designed kitchen or bathroom.

title: Great set of cookware - makes a great gift. Pratical and useful for most kitchens.
text: Great set of pots for the novice cook. These would be great as a shower gift for the bride to be or even just a house warming gift for the first time homeowner/apartment dweller or kid going off to college. Practical, attractive (I absolutely adore this red color) and has pot and pan sizes to meet most daily cooking needs. Adding in the two spatulars is just icing on the cake (work perfectly with the non-stick surface). As others have mentioned, for about $50 more you could buy a more advanced set. However, this set makes a great presentation and has the impressive Paul Deen name on it. I have several of her products in my own kitchen and I know that she does deliver quality products.

title: Not just for wine - every day use as well!
text: These are fantastic glasses! Beautiful design, ergonomically fits perfectly in my hand and well made (sturdy glass). I can see where these will be very resistant to breakage (unlike a lot of stem wine glasses I have). However, I must point out that these can be use for most any purpose (also unlike wine stem glasses). I have used them for orange juice in the morning at my breakfast table. In any event, these are beautiful, strong glasses. Another quality product by Schott Zwiesel! A must have for any homeowner/apartment dweller. Would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift for sure!

title: Absolutely gorgeous large countertop oven!
text: Beautiful addition to my kitchen. I must preface this that this is replacing another Oster oven I have had for about 2 years that is a tad larger. I will probably miss that I won't be able to cook the same size roasting chickens, etc, in this. But overall I am thrilled. I absolutely love the French doors. My old one had a door which opened down and could occasionally burn me if I wasn't careful putting food in or even simply closing it again. The French doors work in tandem and close flawlessly. I also think this unit is more energy efficient as well as my kitchen doesn't seem to warm up the way it did when I had my old counter top Oster going. No complaints, beautifully modern and looks wonderful on my countertop!

title: Great broom, no instructions included for assembly
text: Nice size, attractive broom. Rating in 4 stars instead of 5 as it comes in pieces, with no instructions (not even on the cardboard which held it together). Although I was able to figure out the basic, there were some screws and some metal pieces that I couldn't figure out (I am assuming maybe it is a brace to attach to a wall?). Anyway, I rating it as a brush/broom it works well.

title: Another great Reynolds' product. Kudos!!!
text: As I have said in other reviews, I absolutely love Reynolds products. They always have the chef in mind for easing cooking and clean up needs. These bags are no exception. They are large (can accommodate a small baking chicken) and tough (won't break on it's own. I used these for pork chops last night and filled the bag with onions and seasoning, popped it into the oven for 50 minutes and, yum, cooked to perfection. Clean up was minimal, just a rinse of the pan in the sink and I was good to go. Every kitchen should have a supply of these for every day needs.

title: Great non-stick baking pans!
text: I love all of Reynolds products, and the new bakeware pans are no exception. Perfect size, non-stick (so I don't have to use butter or that scary 'I don't know what is in it' Pam). I made brownies in the first batch and they popped right out. Great fitting lid so I can store and transport easily. No complaints but would love it if they made these in a bigger pack (maybe 6 pans with 3 lids) so it would be more economical and I could reuse lids. Anyway, I will be purchasing more of these for holiday baking use. Kudos Reynolds for another great product!

title: Move over Solo cups!
text: Great cups! Perfect size, love the color! These fit ergonomically in your hands with the Easy Grip technology, allows for no-slippage when you are 'partying hearty', lol. I actual prefer these now to the Solo cups I had been using. My new favorite drink cup for sure!!!!

title: Every kitchen should have one!
text: Great little kitchen gadget. The older I have gotten (just turned 60 this year, yikes!), I find it more and more difficult to unscrew some jars. I am usually banging away at the lid with a knife or a spoon to try to get the seal broken and then I make lame attempts at trying to unscrew. Usually end up giving it to my son or nephew (or whoever may be around) to do it. With this new Hamilton Beach Jar Opener, I no longer need anyone! It is easy to use and compact. Quite a conversation maker, too. If you are looking for an add on bridal shower gift, or something no one else would ever think of, this is it. I highly recommend!

title: Great glasses for the sports enthusiast!
text: Got these as a Christmas gift for my brother (huge Giants fan relocated to Florida). He absolutely loves them and uses them all the time. Well made, great Giants logo, has been in and out of the dishwasher now many, many times and they look as good now as they did last December.

title: Amazing quality mattress at a reasonable price!
text: This is a great high quality mattress for the price. I rated it as only 4 out of 5 stars for several reasons. First is the way it is packed. I understand that unlike a brick and mortar store that will deliver mattresses to your home, this has to come standard shipping (this came UPS), however the mattress is rolled tightly to fit in a box that is very HEAVY and I needed assistance from the neighbors just to get it inside my door (over 100 lbs). Secondly, it is rolled in a reverse way that I would pack it (makes it awkward when trying to maneuver it onto a frame). Thirdly, there is a smell to it, but I use an air cleaner in the room so that seemed to clear up once I covered it with a mattress cover and my sheets. On the plus side, surprisingly when unrolled it flattens out to a soft, but firm, mattress and I can say it is almost as good as a mattress I paid three times as much for (Icomfort). If I had known I could have gotten a mattress from Amazon of this quality, I would have saved the money and definitely had bought this one earlier. Alas, it is in my guest bedroom now, but I did sleep on this last night and had one of my best night's sleep to date. I highly recommend this mattress to all!

title: Perfect kitchen cabinet addition!
text: Great lazy susan for the inside of my pantry. I neatly can place spices on it and can clearly rotate and see everything I need at a glance. This is a great gadget for folks, like me, who have basic cabinet structures and need more organization in their lives. I now have two of these and I use them all the time. Great for the apartment owner to customize and optimize closet space.

title: Great gadget! Don't know how I lived without it before!
text: Wow, what a clever idea! I always am making kabobs here in Florida, most of the time chicken but occasionally beef. There is nothing worse than taking the kabobs off the grill and bringing them into the kitchen and trying to remove the meat and vegetables from the skewers. Most times I burn myself trying to get a grip on the charcoaled metal.
